summary: Join our comprehensive Banking Sector Resolution and Recovery Planning Training Course. Learn strategies to navigate financial challenges and ensure stability.
lede: Bank recovery and resolution planning helps banking risk, treasury, supervision, and governance professionals prepare for financial distress. Participants learn to set measurable triggers, assess recovery options, map critical functions and dependencies, and understand resolution tools and stakeholder roles. Scenario exercises also develop escalation procedures and crisis coordination for decisions affecting liquidity, capital, governance, and confidence.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for financial professionals who are on the front lines of banking stability and risk management.
audience: Bank risk managers and enterprise risk leaders
Bank executives and senior management teams
Deposit insurance professionals and resolution authorities
Legal, governance, and corporate secretariat teams
Crisis management, business continuity, and operational resilience
modules: Foundations of Recovery and Resolution Planning
Early Warning Indicators and Recovery Triggers
Credible Recovery Options and Feasibility Testing
Recovery Plan Governance and Crisis Playbooks
Critical Functions, Core Services, and Operational Continuity
Barriers to Resolvability and How to Fix Them
Communication and Coordination in a Crisis
Testing, Dry Runs, and Continuous Improvement
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of banking operations and risk management. Familiarity with regulatory frameworks and crisis management concepts is recommended but not required.
